1A.name: k1
inputs: Drag the workstation and my laptop into the kitchen.

1A.name: k2
inputs: Lift the passenger seat and the back door, then open my laptop.

1A.name: k3
inputs: Push the driver's seat and my laptop out of the truck.

1A.name: k4
inputs: Rotate the workstation, then open my laptop.

1A.name: k7
inputs: Roll the workstation toward the window.

1A.name: k8
inputs: Nudge the back door a foot to the left.

1A.name: k10
inputs: Press on the drawer to check that it is closed.

1A.name: k12
inputs: Slide the drawer open, then close the drawer.
